name: Baked rice with confit tomatoes and garlic
intro: a pan of simmering water strangely difficult, this will be a revelation. Just make

ingredients.item: large garlic cloves (or 25 small), peeled (⅔ cup/85g)
large shallots, cut into 1¼-inch/3cm pieces (1 cup/220g)
cups/25g cilantro stems, cut into 1½-inch/4cm lengths, plus ½ cup/10g leaves, roughly chopped, to serve
tbsp/100ml olive oil salt and black pepper

method: Arrange the tomatoes, garlic, shallots, cilantro stems, thyme, and cinnamon sticks in a large high-sided casserole dish, about 8 x 12 inches/20 x 30cm. Pour in the olive oil, add ½ tsp of salt and a good grind of black pepper, and place in the oven for 1 hour, until the vegetables are soft. Remove from the oven, sprinkle the rice evenly over the vegetables, without stirring them together, and set aside.

Sprinkle ½ tsp of salt and plenty of black pepper over the rice and then carefully pour the boiling water over the rice. Seal the dish tightly with foil and place in the oven for 25 minutes, until the rice is cooked. Remove from the oven and set aside for 10 minutes, still covered. Remove the foil, sprinkle with the cilantro leaves, stir these very gently into the rice, and serve.
